title: Trump Advisers Lutnick, Michael Meet With Anthropic Executive Over AI Safety
description: Senior Trump administration officials met Tuesday with Anthropic PBC’s top Washington executive to discuss artificial intelligence safety risks.

title: Nvidia’s Huang Set to Attend Trump Dinner With Chinese President
description: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang is slated to attend President Donald Trump’s state dinner with Chinese leader Xi Jinping next week, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: US Coast Guard Boards Oil Tanker in Cyber Attack Investigation
description: US military forces and FBI agents boarded a Texas-bound oil tanker to investigate a cyberattack, the Coast Guard confirmed late Tuesday.
